title: Focused-transcript zoom view not driven by authoritative daemon stream — 4 symptoms, one subsystem
wanted_capability: The single-agent zoom view's buffer + status + repaint should be faithfully driven by the daemon focused-transcript stream and authoritative task status. Four operator-observed symptoms, one tranche: D8 first user turn renders twice (backfill not deduped against optimistically-rendered turns); D9 nav out/back loses scrollback (re-focus reopens SSE but doesn't restore/re-request the history buffer — daemon supports history paging per 777c18e); D10 new lines don't appear live while zoomed (inline render loop ~fleet_tui.rs:1786 doesn't wake/repaint on FocusedTranscriptMsg::Stream events); D11 throbber shows "working" with climbing timer on a Finished agent (stale local active flag + wall-clock-since-focus timer, not gated on status.is_terminal()). Related: D5 — started_at for reloaded rows hydrated from last_event_at (crates/.../task.rs:175), so the "started" column shows last-activity time. Fix as ONE tranche on the inline/zoomed render loop + start_focused_transcript + FocusedTranscriptBuffer, not four scattered patches.
notes: D8+D9+D10+D11 (+D5) from thread-4719ad45. LIVE-VALIDATED 2026-06-11 via tmux MCP probe (agent 24cc2d4b, brodex, single short task; ground truth from bro_status): D8 CONFIRMED — first user turn `▌ ls -la` rendered twice at the top of the zoom view. D10 CONFIRMED, and worse than described — task completed at 18s but the zoomed view never rendered the final assistant message, AND a nav-out/nav-in refocus STILL showed the transcript ending at the tool result (refocus backfill also misses the final message + completion). D11 CONFIRMED again — throbber showed "working 39s" then "working 1m14s" climbing for the completed task, persisting across refocus. D9 NOT REPRODUCED on this probe — refocus restored full scrollback — but the 2-turn transcript fits one screen, so "only last turn or two render" is indistinguishable from full restore; needs a longer multi-turn session to discriminate before treating as refuted. D5 (started_at hydrated from last_event_at, task.rs:175) remains code-verified only. Fix as ONE tranche on the inline/zoomed render loop + start_focused_transcript + FocusedTranscriptBuffer.
resolution_note: Fixed by the 2026-06-10 21:25 fleet TUI campaign (another machine; e.g. e9103fa inline_stable_end watermark, 239ced2 cockpit truthfulness), already merged into beta/blackbox-v2. Re-validated live 2026-06-11 on a HEAD-build cockpit (2c68365) via tmux MCP, two probe dispatches: D8 first turn renders once; D10 new lines + final assistant message render live while zoomed; D11 footer flips to "✓ took 31s" (honest elapsed) on completion; D9 nav out/in restores full multi-screen scrollback. My earlier same-day "live confirmations" were against a pre-campaign binary (built Jun 10 16:29) and are void. Minor residual NOT worth its own gap: started_at hydration now prefers task.started_at (bro-fleet-client task.rs:201) but one path still falls back to last_event_at (task.rs:230).
